verdict.rationale: Convex's open-source self-hosted backend (docs-8/19/30/40, convex-gh-1) and CLI's `npx convex import` (docs-26) show real data portability and the ability to run your own copy of the stack, and HTTP endpoints (docs-9/31) allow programmatic data access. However, the evidence pack has no explicit documentation of a `convex export` command or any officially supported 'export all data to open format (e.g. JSON/CSV) and leave' workflow, and the docs-md/OpenAPI probes returned 404s, so there's no confirmed structured export path beyond self-hosting your own instance. missing for 10: explicit export/backup command or documented data-export API, evidence of exported format (JSON/CSV) being fully open and complete, and independent confirmation someone has migrated away using this path.
